effective_project_units.unified-display:
# /etc/systemd/system/unified-display.service
[Unit]
Description=One shared full XFCE desktop outside application containers
After=network.target
[Service]
User=workspace
Environment=HOME=/home/workspace
Environment=XAUTHORITY=/srv/unified/state/auth/host
ExecStart=/usr/bin/xpra start-desktop :100 --daemon=no --bind-tcp=127.0.0.1:8081 --sharing=yes --html=/usr/share/xpra/www --resize-display=1280x800 --xvfb="/usr/lib/xorg/Xorg -noreset -nolisten tcp -config /srv/unified/xorg-shared.conf -logfile /srv/unified/state/xorg-shared.log +extension RANDR +extension RENDER" --start-child="dbus-run-session xfce4-session" --mdns=no --pulseaudio=no --webcam=no --printing=no --notifications=no --exit-with-children=no
ExecStartPost=/bin/bash /srv/unified/prepare-auth.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
Nice=5
MemoryMax=1536M
CPUQuota=75%
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/unified-display.service.d/modes.conf
[Service]
ExecStart=
ExecStart=/usr/bin/xpra start-desktop :100 --daemon=no --bind-tcp=127.0.0.1:8081 --sharing=yes --html=/usr/share/xpra/www --resize-display=off:1280x800@50 --xvfb="/usr/lib/xorg/Xorg -noreset -nolisten tcp -config /srv/unified/xorg-shared.conf -logfile /srv/unified/state/xorg-shared.log +extension RANDR +extension RENDER" --start-child="dbus-run-session xfce4-session" --mdns=no --pulseaudio=no --webcam=no --printing=no --notifications=no --exit-with-children=no --encoding=png --encodings=png --speed=100 --min-speed=100 --quality=100 --min-quality=100 --auto-refresh-delay=0 --keyboard-sync=no --bandwidth-limit=1000000 --bandwidth-detection=no
Environment=XPRA_BATCH_MIN_DELAY=100
Environment=XPRA_BATCH_START_DELAY=100
effective_project_units.unified-apps:
# /etc/systemd/system/unified-apps.service
[Unit]
Description=Application containers in one host desktop
After=docker.service unified-display.service
Requires=docker.service unified-display.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
WorkingDirectory=/srv/unified
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker compose up -d
ExecStop=/usr/bin/docker compose stop
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
effective_project_units.unified-status:
# /etc/systemd/system/unified-status.service
[Unit]
Description=Read-only container status endpoint
After=docker.service
[Service]
User=workspace
SupplementaryGroups=docker
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/unified/web/status.py
Restart=on-failure
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
effective_project_units.unified-modes:
# /etc/systemd/system/unified-modes.service
[Unit]
Description=Independent host desktops and original unified desktop
After=unified-display.service unified-apps.service unified-desktop-a.service unified-desktop-b.service unified-desktop-c.service
Requires=unified-display.service unified-apps.service
Wants=unified-desktop-a.service unified-desktop-b.service unified-desktop-c.service
[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=workspace
Environment=DISPLAY=:100
Environment=XAUTHORITY=/srv/unified/state/auth/host
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/unified/modes/controller.py start
RemainAfterExit=yes
TimeoutStartSec=180
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# /etc/systemd/system/unified-modes.service.d/readiness.conf
[Service]
TimeoutStartSec=150
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
effective_project_units.unified-mode-status:
# /etc/systemd/system/unified-mode-status.service
[Unit]
Description=Read-only standard desktop geometry
After=network.target
[Service]
User=workspace
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/unified/modes/status_server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

Environment=XPRA_BATCH_MIN_DELAY=100
ExecStart=/usr/bin/xpra start-desktop :103 --daemon=no --bind-tcp=127.0.0.1:8103 --sharing=yes --html=/usr/share/xpra/www --resize-display=off:1280x800@50 --xvfb="/usr/lib/xorg/Xorg -noreset -nolisten tcp -config /srv/unified/xorg-shared.conf -logfile /srv/unified/state/desktops/c/xorg.log +extension RANDR +extension RENDER" --start-child="dbus-run-session xfce4-session" --mdns=no --pulseaudio=no --webcam=no --printing=no --notifications=yes --exit-with-children=no --encoding=png --encodings=png --speed=100 --min-speed=100 --quality=100 --min-quality=100 --auto-refresh-delay=0 --keyboard-sync=no --bandwidth-limit=250000 --bandwidth-detection=no
ExecStartPost=/bin/bash /srv/unified/modes/prepare-desktop-auth.sh c
ExecStartPost=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/unified/modes/desktops.py start c
TimeoutStartSec=180
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
MemoryMax=1024M
Nice=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

scope: Only this project, its runtime requirements and project-owned desktop configuration; no complete machine package inventory, private credentials, user documents, physical machine identifiers or unrelated services.
